title: CminiTorch
headline: Tensors, automatic differentiation, and neural networks in C.
summary: A dependency-free C library with tensors, reverse-mode automatic differentiation and trainable neural networks.
bullets: Dynamic computation graphs with shared parameters and topological backward traversal.
CNN and causal Transformer layers, SGD and Adam, plus scoped memory ownership.
Finite-difference gradient checks for operators and complete networks.

title: Sign Language Recognition
headline: Local ASL recognition with a native desktop interface.
summary: An ASL recognition system combining a training pipeline with a native desktop application.
bullets: Landmark-based features feed a CNN and Transformer architecture.
Recognition, recording and inference settings live in a PySide6 desktop app.
Reported evaluation: 86.89% Top-1 on PopSign with six unseen signers across 250 signs.

title: Foundations Toolkit
headline: Memory management, data structures, and linear algebra.
summary: Implementations of memory management, data structures and linear algebra for ML systems engineering.
bullets: Manual memory management and dynamic arrays in C.
Python data structures and a matrix class with Gaussian elimination.
A learn-by-building approach connecting derivations, implementation and benchmarks.

title: SDID Academic Portal
headline: Course materials, assignments, and grading.
summary: A collaborative academic portal for course materials, submissions, grading and administration.
bullets: Role-based workflows for administrators, instructors and students.
Separated API and frontend with course and submission management.
Built with Mohammed Sabri and Anas Joundy, as credited in the repository.

title: Knowledge Garden
headline: An Obsidian reader and engineering portfolio.
summary: The website you are reading: an Obsidian reader, linked knowledge library and engineering portfolio.
bullets: Markdown notes become searchable pages with math, links and backlinks.
A Dewey-style subject directory connects notes and maps of content.
A Vercel frontend proxies requests to a PythonAnywhere API.

title: Centre Beauty Souad
headline: A service catalog and booking website.
summary: A responsive salon website with searchable services, a package calculator and WhatsApp booking.
bullets: Filterable service catalog and interactive before/after comparison.
A price calculator assembles a booking message for WhatsApp.
A static site deployed on Vercel.

title: RateYourMusic Shuffler
headline: An album picker for a RateYourMusic collection.
summary: A small Flask app that picks an album from pasted RateYourMusic collection text.
bullets: Parses collection text without scraping or relying on an RYM API.
Minimum-rating filters narrow the listening choices.
Links the selected album to YouTube and Spotify searches.

title: Python Avancé
headline: Advanced Python workshops and notebooks.
summary: IAGI workshops and notebooks for the Advanced Python module at ENSAM.
